response.original_title: Blues Traveler: Live at Ryman Auditorium, Nashville, TN – October 21, 2025
response.overview: Blues Traveler bring their Fall Tour 2025 to Nashville's Ryman Auditorium on October 21, 2025, captured in full as an All Access exclusive livestream for nugs.net. John Popper, Chan Kinchla, Brendan Hill, Tad Kinchla and Ben Wilson open with a harmonica-led charge through The Charlie Daniels Band's "The Devil Went Down to Georgia" before running the hits - "Run-Around", "But Anyway", "The Mountains Win Again", "Carolina Blues" and "Hook" - alongside extended jams on "Brother John" and a Rush "YYZ" that circles back to the Devil for a reprise. Keyboardist Ben Wilson steps up to sing Van Halen's "Hot for Teacher", Spin Doctors frontman Chris Barron joins for "Champipple", and the night closes on the Mother Church stage with a Grateful Dead "Althea".
response.title: Blues Traveler: Live at Ryman Auditorium, Nashville, TN – October 21, 2025
